title: Locked and hidden
lead: Agents cannot change what is locked or hidden here, nor anything below such a folder, and they cannot read what is hidden. You can still read and change all of it, unlock it or unhide it.

unavailable.title: The server is not answering right now.
unavailable.detail: The locked and hidden items cannot be shown. Reload this page in a moment.

listTitle: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing is locked} one {# locked item} other {# locked items}}
none: Nothing is locked. Agents with the lock permission can lock notes and folders.
covered: {folders, plural, one {# folder} other {# folders}} and {notes, plural, one {# note} other {# notes}} below it

unauthenticated.title: Signed out
unauthenticated.detail: Your session has ended. Sign in again.

not_found.title: No longer there
not_found.detail: It was deleted or moved meanwhile. The list is up to date again.

folder_not_found.title: No longer there
folder_not_found.detail: The folder was deleted meanwhile. The list is up to date again.

unexpected.title: Something went wrong
unexpected.detail: The server gave an unexpected answer. Try again.

hidden.listTitle: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing is hidden} one {# hidden item} other {# hidden items}}
hidden.none: Nothing is hidden. You and agents with the hide permission can hide notes and folders.

confirm.title: Make this visible to agents again?
confirm.detail: Every agent that can reach this note will be able to read it again. A lock on it stays.
confirm.detailFolder: Every agent that can reach this folder will be able to see and read everything below it again. A lock on it stays.
confirm.passwordHint: For the next 10 minutes you will not be asked again.
